notes: Kill the ~1.5s lag before the 'Get started' empty state appears. loadSegments() retries once after 1500ms when it sees no scenes — needed for post-generation reloads (Content.json is briefly empty mid-build), but pointless on a cold page load or right after a delete, where empty is authoritative. Now the startup auto-load passes retries=0 when it already knows there are no scenes, and deleteScene/clearAllScenes do the same, so the empty state shows in ~15-30ms instead of ~1535ms. Measured: 1535ms -> 16ms on load, 33ms on delete-to-empty.
